title: Heavily AI-Assisted Top-down Roguelite (WIP)
author: Jarros
selftext: 90% of code and visuals here are made with AI.

comments.author: lostforever2011
comments.body: Looks very nice. Can you share which tools you used pls? Specifically which tool/how did you create the art assets pls?

comments.author: Am_Biyori
comments.body: The character movement is nice. Though it might seem strange, the fog of war effect looks strange using the tiles instead of looking like a fog. Trees blowing in the wind and some critters running around would be nice too.

comments.author: Glebasya
comments.body: I would say tiles look weird and don't stitch together. Maybe you can try to generate several (2 by 2, for example) tiles at once and split them?

replies.author: Ray_Light91
replies.body:
I'd suggest a texture version of a 4x4 grid but actually only using the 3x3 section of it.

For the moving assets, not 2 states but 3-5 states depending on how visible they are.

For the rest, very nice imho!

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body: Do the legs move when the character is moving in top-left direction

comments.author: hellfish121
comments.body: Need to work on the tiling. There are a few techniques out there, but I had decent luck with adding noise textures to it, or explicitly building one large seamless tile, and then sampling from it for variation.

comments.author: Virtualeaf
comments.body: you should checkout summerengine.com and go cook some more cool games!

comments.author: kauthonk
comments.body: Did you have to create the map manually or is it auto generated and how did the design process work.

comments.author: Chologism
comments.body:
Wow this is one of the best looking games I've seen on this sub, well done!

I noticed the grid pattern in the tiling and I actually just released an alpha version of my tileset generator if you want to give it a try:
https://www.spritecook.ai/blog/top-down-tileset

Also made a free open source tileset base generator so you can give AI a starting point to work with: https://www.spritecook.ai/tileset-base-generator

Maybe that can be useful
